changelog:
Task Prism v4.1 is a major simplification and streamlining release.

- Removed legacy pseudo-Agent, tool definition, and input validation gate logic for simplicity.
- Reduced fault tolerance rules from 9 to 4 and core principles from 12 to 6, focusing on essentials.
- Refined the self-checklist to 15 core points plus mode-specific extensions.
- Dropped skill-card.md and other unnecessary context management content.
- Retained full functionality and four working modes, but with clearer, more concise guidance.
- Documentation rewritten to be more focused and user-friendly.
